brief.question: Rebuild/upgrade the Pontaj Ture time-tracking app in its own folder: keep 100% of existing functionality (calculations, wizard, modals, guides), make it properly responsive (viewport-fit=cover, safe-area insets, no unwanted horizontal scroll), make it work offline + as a PWA (service worker pre-caches index.html, styles.css, app.js, guides.js, guides-data.json, icons, locale pages; manifest.json), make the Supabase integration not break when offline and not force a blocking login on open, use relative ./ paths, then bump the SW cache version, clean old caches, and run `node build.js` to finalize dist/.
constraints: Change files only inside the project folder (its own folder, not a new app/ instance); the workspace IS the project.
Do not change data: nothing else to study. Keep 100% functionality of calculations, wizard, modals, guides.
Run `node build.js` at the end to update dist/.
Never start dev servers, watchers or anything that doesn't exit.

plan.title: Survey the project files (README/AGENTS/MECHANICS + index.html + app.js overview)
plan.why: Understood existing structure and functionality first

plan.title: Record unknowns for evidence gaps with core_unknown_add
Responsive: viewport-fit=cover, safe-area, no h-scroll
plan.why: Body padding includes env(safe-area-*), min-height 100dvh, overflow-x hidden on html/body; index.html + calculator-salariu.html updated

plan.title: PWA: tolerant install + SW pre-caches guides-data.json etc., manifest + icons + apple-touch-icon
plan.why: SW caches critical assets (dist: all; root: all except 4 generated scripts); manifest links icon, apple-touch-icon added

plan.title: Supabase offline: try/catch on getSession + loadDataFromSupabase; relative ./ paths kept
plan.why: No unhandled rejections when offline; cloud errors swallowed; local data preserved

plan.title: Bump SW cache version, purge old caches, run `node build.js`
plan.why: dist/ rebuilt with version 4ef7ed7f14a5; activate purges old caches; build hash covers sw.js so version bumps every change

plan.title: Verify with rebuild_check; fix differences
plan.why: Craft Anything runs its own checks after the turn

handoff:
Responsiv: index.html + calculator-salariu.html au viewport-fit=cover; styles.css: body padding = calc(2rem + env(safe-area-inset-top/right/bottom/left)) + min-height:100dvh + html/body { overflow-x: hidden } (styles.css line ~54-62, ~638, ~1068).
PWA: sw.js (root, placeholder __BUILD_VERSION__ neinjectat) + dist/sw.js: ASSETS include index.html, calculator-salariu.html, iphone.html, styles.css, app.js, supabase.js, holidays-data.js, mechanics-data.js, guides-data.js, guides.js, guides-data.json, modules/day-details.js, holidays-data.json, mechanics-data.json, manifest.json, icon.svg, icon-192.png, icon-512.png, apple-touch-icon.png; install tolerant (Promise.allSettled — în root lipsește supabase.js/holidays-data.js/mechanics-data.js/guides-data.js, exist în dist); fallback 404 la navigation și la scripte offline-fără-copie.
Manifest: icons + start_url index.html + scope . ; apple-touch-icon link adăugat la index.html (AGENTS rule 1).
App/JS: app.js: checkSupabaseSession + loadDataFromSupabase au try/catch offline (nu blochează la deschidere; markCloudPending la offline). sw.js: tolerant install; app.js: --check OK.
Build: node build.js rulezat — dist/ regenerat; cache version 4ef7ed7f14a5 (hashul include sw.js); activate purge-ază vechile cache-uri. dist: == root + ?v=4ef7ed7f14a5 pe script/link-uri și fișiere generate (supabase.js etc.). rebuild_check: PASSED (build passed, no tests).
APK: build-apk.js se termină cu 'toolchain Android absență' (nu există java/apktool/aapt) — nu se poate construi APK acum; dist/ contine doar site-ul (reconstruirea APK va avea nevoie de un PC cu toolchain).
Remaining manual: browser-verify offline (încărcați ~/Documents/Craft Anything/Pontaj Ture/index.html cu rețeaua oprită, verificați consola), observați dacă calculele/renderingul par OK, și decideți dacă trebuie lansat APK-ul oarecare.
Traps: root/sw.js păstrează __BUILD_VERSION__ (normal dev); în root, noteșteți că SW instalează 'pontaj-ture-v__BUILD_VERSION__' ca nume de cache literal.
